name: Cloud Connector Pipeline
researcher_notes: No existing row under another name: checked Gator Express, CP Express, Haynesville Global Access (cancelled), Louisiana Energy Gateway, Acadian Haynesville Extension and others. Venture Global filed its Plaquemines Expansion application with FERC in November 2025. The feed gas would come from this new intrastate Louisiana line, which is not under FERC. An Arbo Research note from December 2025 gives a 48 inch pipe, roughly 300 miles, 4.5 Bcf/d, phased in service with final completion in February 2029. A trade press report of the filing from November 2025 names the pipeline and says it connects Haynesville gas to other intrastate lines. A September 2026 Baker Hughes release says it will supply 13 gas compression systems for the line, which is the concrete step. The length is a rounded figure from one analyst note. A web search summary mentioned 340 miles but we could not confirm that in the page text, so it is not used. Start year 2029 is the final completion date. Exact route and endpoints are not published, so the start is given only as the Haynesville area. Route: none found, RouteAccuracy no route. Owner: Venture Global has no legal form in the ownership team list, so it is written as the source spells it. Confidence medium: two independent outlets, no regulator document, since the pipeline is state-regulated and we did not find a Louisiana filing.
